about-subtitle: +4 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE IN FULLSTACK DEVELOPMENT
about-1-p: Full-stack developer with 4+ years of experience building web applications and ERP systems, primarily with Angular, .NET and Node.js. My work has focused on modernizing internal tooling — from documentation systems to build and deployment pipelines.
about-2-p: I led the design and implementation of our build and deploy automation using Azure DevOps, cutting the release cycle for our core Infrastructure-as-Code projects from a full day to roughly 2 hours. This involved auditing our existing infrastructure, redesigning deployment strategies across our servers, and working closely with the team to ensure every system could integrate reliably into the new pipeline.
about-3-p: I communicate fluently in Portuguese and English, both in-person and remote, and I'm always looking for the next problem worth solving.
services-subtitle: WHAT I CAN DO FOR YOU
services-frontend-card: I develop modern and responsive user interfaces designed in Figma and use technologies like Bootstrap and SCSS to ensure intuitive navigation.
services-backend-card: I create secure and efficient backend solutions in C# or Node.js, with database integration and a focus on performance and scalability.
services-rest-card: I develop and document secure and scalable RESTful APIs, as well as integrate third-party APIs.
